intro: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im is a bounty posted by the authorities in Lakeshire against a hostile orc commander entrenched in Render's Valley. Gar'im commands a dangerous contingent of shadowcasters and is purported to be working with the Blackrock clan holding Stonewatch Keep. Magistrate Solomon offers a handsome bounty for proof of his demise.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What do you have there, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work, friend! Incinerator Gar'im was preparing to bolster the defenses at Stonewatch Keep. With this victory, we may yet succeed in reclaiming the keep!
